Written by the company

ChangeNOW.io is a crypto management platform that empowers newcomers, professionals and businesses to handle their Web3 finances in a simple and secure way. Since 2017, ChangeNOW has evolved from a fast, secure and limitless instant crypto exchange to a platform where millions of users worldwide safely store, exchange, trade and stake their crypto assets.

ChangeNOW Crypto Exchange: Swap on the Go

Written by the company

ChangeNOW offers rapid swaps for BTC, ETH, USDT, and hundreds of other assets directly to your wallet. We’ve removed the friction so you can focus on your gains, not on filling out forms.

Resilient by Design, Secure by DNA

Enjoy all the benefits of ChangeNOW:

  • Signup-Free: Keep your swaps private.
  • Massive Variety: Access 1500+ digital assets across 110+ blockchains.
  • Your Keys, Your Coins: Your funds stay yours only – safe and secure.
  • Fiat-Ready: Jump from money to better money instantly with support for 70+ fiat currencies.

Go PRO: Maximize Every Move

Upgrade your experience with a ChangeNOW PRO subscription plan and get more benefits, control, transparency, and efficiency.

Choose the plan that fits your strategy:

  • Emerald: 0.1% Cashback + 40 AML Checks – Built for active clients who want smarter monitoring and added value.
  • Brilliant: 0.2% Cashback + Unlimited AML Checks – Designed for power users who need flexibility, scale, and full compliance coverage.
